https://oer19.oerconf.org/news/blog-can-we-decolonize-oer-open-decolonizeopen/ this is why #OER needs to be HTML first. Forget newfangled frameworks keep it friendly and readable.

You can learn structure of a webpage in a day. We have done it with broken bricks and no computers.

Can't do that with React. #IndieWeb
